title: Understanding the Hat Matrix
text: The hat matrix $H$ is defined as $H=X(X**TX)**{-1}X**T$. It is used in linear regression to project the observed values onto the fitted values.

title: Properties of the Hat Matrix
text: One key property of the hat matrix $H$ is that it is idempotent, meaning $H**2=H$. This means that applying the hat matrix twice is the same as applying it once.

title: Idempotent Matrices
text: An idempotent matrix is a matrix which, when multiplied by itself, yields itself. This is a characteristic property of the hat matrix in linear regression.

title: Checking Idempotency
text: To check if $H$ is idempotent, compute $H**2$ and see if it equals $H$.
